notes: Overture h=6.1 m is wrong. Block heights are estimates: linked blocks at 7 storeys with the railway-side block raised to 10 storeys (the press figure). Facade materials were not found in any source: pale grey rainscreen panels with storey-high window strips and coloured reveals are an assumption.
